source: test fixture — an operator-authored entry whose only spelling of a name is capitalised
description: The json parser trims aliases but does not lower-case them, so an operator file can carry a name spelled ONLY in mixed case. That is the shape in which DrugReference.nameKeys()'s own normalisation is load-bearing: the query side of DrugReferenceService.entriesNamedBy normalises whatever it is asked, so an index keyed on the RAW alias silently loses this entry as a claimant of 'warfarin' while DrugReference.isNamed still finds it. Two entries, because losing a claimant only changes an answer where a second substance claims the same name — and that is exactly what DrugSafetyValidator.unambiguouslyNames is comparing, so the drift is fail-OPEN: fewer rivals means the gate permits a displacement it should refuse (issue #296).
